Oiê artwork is adapted from Noto Emoji.
Copyright 2013 Google LLC and Noto Emoji contributors.

Upstream: https://github.com/googlefonts/noto-emoji
Pinned commit: 99701e07d3d1fe1bdbcdb14964547f0fd592966f

Source SVGs:
- 2D/svg/emoji_u1f31a.svg
- 2D/svg/emoji_u1f4ac.svg

The unchanged upstream SVGs, their SHA-256 digests, URLs and upstream README
are retained in source/brand/oie in the araihu/assets source repository.
The derived identity reuses the official speech balloon and moon facial paths.
The face is translated by (0,-13) in the original 128-unit coordinate system.
The ellipsis, balloon outline, gradients, shading and cheek highlights were
removed. Oiê lettering is independently drawn as vector paths, not a Noto font.
Appearance variants change fills while preserving the source geometry.

The pinned upstream README identifies tools and most image resources as Apache
License 2.0, and font software as SIL Open Font License 1.1. This distribution
adapts SVG image resources and includes no Noto font software. Apache-2.0.txt
contains Apache 2.0. The original upstream top-level font license is also
preserved as noto-emoji-upstream-OFL.txt. File locations within a distribution
may differ; consumers must retain these notices and license texts.

The result is an adapted work, not an unmodified Noto emoji or a Google-endorsed
identity. Brand terms do not replace the original licenses of third-party art.
